title: Candy Golden Hearts
description: Adds golden candy in the shape of hearts, heals absorption
body:
currently archived since i dont really update this that much at all

i literally made this in 7 hours nonstop, you need a mod that adds to minecraft:generic.max_absorption otherwise it wont do anything (unless took damage while having absorption effect)

this mod adds **ONE** item called candy golden heart, it gives the same nutrition as an apple, but it also heals 2 hearts (4 points) to the absorption hearts (if you have any)
